action_items: (Optional low-prio) De-duplicate the success toast in HierarchicalSubs.submitGift — the same 'تم إرسال الهدية إلى 1 مستخدم' fires twice. Likely caused by the per-user loop calling toast.success inside .map and an aggregate toast afterwards, or React StrictMode double-invocation in dev. Consider single aggregated toast after Promise.all.
(Optional, from iter28) /api/search 500 'Search error: family_id' still unaddressed — unrelated to this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: superadmin.py::send_user_gift correctly uses upsert on user_subscriptions for extend_trial & free_subscription. extend_trial sets end_date from `now + days` — NOTE: this OVERWRITES any existing longer end_date instead of extending forward from the existing end_date when current sub is still active. If user already has 60 days left and admin gifts 7 days, they lose 53 days. Recommend: compute new_end = max(existing.end_date, now) + days. (Behavioural — confirm product intent with user.)

superadmin.py::get_hierarchical_subscriptions — builds users_by_compound in memory for 5000 users max; O(N) scans but acceptable at this scale. totals.managers counts 'manager' + 'company_admin' (good) but totals.family_heads is returned while UI sticky bar doesn't display it — harmless extra.

superadmin.py::get_compound_full_details — ads query uses `$or` with `target_compounds: []` and missing field — this may return ALL global ads not targeted at this compound, including those targeted exclusively at OTHER compounds when the field is missing; confirm intent. Also subscription fallback uses $in on ALL manager/company_admin/app_owner users in the compound — may pick an unrelated sub.
HierarchicalSubs.js — gift modal closes via setGiftTarget(null) only on success loop completion; if one user fails in a batch, the modal stays open but a partial success toast already fired — OK UX.

HierarchicalSubs.js exportCsv — does NOT escape CR/LF inside cell values; an 'address' field with newline could break the CSV. Low risk since backend data is normalized, but consider .replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').
HierarchicalSubs.js — `filteredData` useMemo rebuilds full tree on every keystroke of search; for large datasets (>2000 users) could lag. Fine at current scale.
auth_deps.require_super_admin correctly allows only super_admin & app_owner roles — verified by the 403 test for regular admin.
